title: CPU greedy next-token boundary for pinned DeepSeek V4.1 recipe

upstream.adapted_behavior: ordered candidate argmax with strict greater-than replacement; ties keep the first/lowest token ID

implementation.prompt_factory: admits only the pinned tokenizer digest and model revision; a private admission seal binds the token-ID digest, context limit and reservation before decoder construction
implementation.numerical_policy: NaN, positive infinity, and all-masked rows reject without state mutation; negative infinity is an allowed masked candidate
implementation.terminal_policy: EOS and max_new_tokens end the decoder; further sampling is refused; only a finished decoder may cross the EOS-safe prefix boundary

verification.prompt_sampler_feature_harness: offline compilation of actual prompt/sampler plus stream feature against deepseek-recipe 0.2.0, deepseek-recipe-core/encoding 0.2.0, tokenizers 0.23.2 and VoltaFabric SHA-256; 9 passed, 3 pinned-tokenizer tests ignored
verification.pinned_tokenizer_integration_test: added but ignored; external VF_DEEPSEEK_V41_TOKENIZER_JSON fixture unavailable to this run

next_action: Connect the logits provider produced by authenticated resident checkpoint owners to this one-token CPU boundary under a new request identity; refuse partial tensor sets and keep GPU/production admission separate.
